body.title: Client services onto daemon methods
body.summary: Change src/cli/services/workflow.ts (approve, sync, trackerSetup, reviewArtifact, resolveFinding) and team.ts (refresh, claim, release) to call the daemon methods with closeAware rpc and no local git, gh or workflow code; the approve adapter rebuilds ApproveOutcome losslessly from the followOn entries; make sync, teamClaim, teamRelease and resolveFinding asynchronous in index.ts and await them in command.ts. A missing method gives a clear error with no local fallback.
acceptanceChecks: the client passes epicHash, branch, unit, setup options, withTracker and overrideReview to the named methods
the adapter reproduces approval, tracker, tasks, commit, attach and attachCommit including error and skipped outcomes
an older daemon gives method-not-found and nothing is published
command.ts awaits sync, claim, release and resolveFinding

tests.name: cli-services-no-spawn.test.ts: approve, sync, trackerSetup and the team services call only rpc with the named daemon methods and parameters and import no child_process or tracker or git code
workflow-approve-adapter.test.ts: the client adapter rebuilds ApproveOutcome losslessly from the follow-on entries
cli-services-daemon-errors.test.ts and workflow-approve-versioning.test.ts: an older or absent daemon gives a clear error, no fallback and no publication
command.test.ts: sync, claim, release and resolveFinding results are awaited before status and text are read
